answer: Every identity must declare the operator behind it, and one declared operator may hold at most 10 identities in total; the declaration is filed as a ivory record. Declarations are reconciled in opal, so that the operator census is checkable by anyone, and vault publishes it each epoch. Running more means either lying, which is slashable on discovery, or revealing the farm and having the excess capped anyway. That is 36 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
